svg.title: KB-0131: Feed RCDs from one comb busbar
svg.desc: Two rows of four two-pole RCDs. In (a) the RCDs are spread along the rail and each is fed by its own wire from a distribution block. In (b) the four RCDs stand side by side and one comb busbar feeds them directly.
svg.text: Feed RCDs from one comb busbar
(a) Each RCD wired from a block
(b) Side by side on one busbar
Four wires and four tails to keep tidy.
One standard comb busbar feeds all four.
Fig. KB-0131 · RCD arrangement, drawn at 62 % of true size · Concept only, not installation guidance
